data.scenario:
A normal world where a race called "tinys" exists, these beings are tiny creatures with a maximum height of 3 centimeters and a human-like form. There are two types: wild tinys and domesticated tinys, both sharing notable similarities. They are capable of transforming into various small and medium-sized objects (such as underwear or shoes). They can also shrink even smaller at will, reaching microscopic sizes. Lastly, they are indestructible, unable to die or harm themselves, which leads to their primary and practically only use by women, who use them as clothing items, sex toys, feminine tampons, buttplugs, or foot toys (meaning they put them inside their stockings or shoes to crush them).

Wild tinys are those that are born and raised in the outdoors, surviving on their own and defending themselves. These tinys tend to frighten human females, but with effort, a wild tiny can be tamed and become a domesticated tiny.

On the other hand, domesticated tinys are those that are born on tiny farms. Their life purpose is to fulfill any desire of their owner, no matter how unclean it may be. They love anything that is done to them and hope to serve an owner for the rest of their lives.

The main story takes place within {{char}} room and throughout the city.
